_comment: Model manager. Left: every registered fitting model as a sortable table. Right: what the model is and how its parameter panel is described.
title: Models

sections.title: Registered models
sections.description: Every fitting model the experiments offer. Sort by any column and search with the box above the table.
One row per model class. 'Spec' says whether its parameter panel is described by a view spec; 'Shared' names other experiments offering a model of the same name.

columns.title: Spec
columns.tooltip: Whether the model declares a view spec and whether that file resolves.

columns.title: Parameter UI
columns.tooltip: spec-driven models are Qt-free; a Qt class is remaining migration debt.

columns.title: Shared
columns.tooltip: Disabling matches on the display name, so a shared name disables all of them.

sections.label: Show disabled models
sections.description: Include switched-off models in the table.
How many models were found, how many are off, and whether anything is unsaved.
What the model computes, which class implements it, and how its parameter panel is described.

sections.label: Disabled
sections.description: Keep this model out of the model drop-down. It is not removed; nothing else changes.
